newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air Canada-Air NZ deal replaces earlier agreement.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada-Air NZ deal replaces earlier agreement.

text.p: Air New Zealand's new code share arrangement with Air Canada effectively replaces its earlier deal with Canadian Airlines, an Air NZ spokesman said on Monday.
Air NZ had previously given Canadian Airlines notice that it would be terminating the agreement, which covers flights into Vancouver and Toronto.
The new agreement would replace that deal with Canadian, but the spokesman said the relationship could develop further as both have links with United Airlines.

Provisions in the agreement cover reciprocal participation in frequent flyer programmes, schedule co-ordination, through check-in, aircraft exchange and, subject to government approval, code sharing. From November, the airlines' schedules and passenger services will be co-ordinated.
